provenance.asset_description: Elf Atavism Feat 1 : Your elven blood runs particularly strong, granting you features far more elven than those of a typical aiuvarin. You may also have been raised among elves, steeped in your elven ancestors' heritage. You gain the benefits of the elf heritage that depends on or improves an elven feature you don't have. For example, you couldn't take the Ancient Elf heritage (page 47) unless your non-elf  ancestry also has a lifespan measured in multiple centuries. In these cases, at the GM's discretion, you might gain a different benefit.
